records.context: Return borrowed controls and detach subscriptions on every exit.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.LiveSettingsDialog.done#0
records.source: Return borrowed controls and detach subscriptions on every exit.
records.translation: Skilar lánsfengnum stýringum og aftengir áskriftir við hverja útgöngu.

records.context: Qt destroys a dialog's children with it, so anything of the panel's still parented under this dialog when it goes would go with it. The controls belong to the panel and retain their values after Close, Escape, accept, reject and explicit completion. Restoring them in ``done`` covers exits that do not deliver a close event. A completed dialog cannot move controls out of a replacement dialog.

records.source: Qt destroys a dialog's children with it, so anything of the panel's still parented under this dialog when it goes would go with it. The controls belong to the panel and retain their values after Close, Escape, accept, reject and explicit completion. Restoring them in ``done`` covers exits that do not deliver a close event. records.translation: Qt eyðir barnaviðmótshlutum glugga þegar glugganum er eytt. Stýringar spjaldsins sem væru enn undir þessum glugga við lokun myndu því einnig hverfa. Stýringarnar tilheyra spjaldinu og halda gildum sínum eftir Close, Escape, accept, reject og skýrt tilgreind verklok. Að skila þeim í ``done`` nær einnig yfir útgöngur sem senda ekki lokunaratburð. Gluggi sem er þegar lokið getur ekki flutt stýringar úr nýjum glugga sem kom í hans stað.
